svg.title: K2 — mountain relief
svg.desc: Southeast face from the Godwin-Austen Glacier. Abruzzi Spur, Black Pyramid, Shoulder, hanging seracs and Bottleneck. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Zacharie Grossen. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Chogori.jpg. License: CC BY-SA 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
